name: Town Square
desc1: The town square of Arlysia is full of run down carts and vending
desc2: booths from a more properous time. Brightly colored signs are now
desc3: faded and falling down. A large statue in the middle of the square is
desc4: crumbling and some sort of fungus appears to be growing on the bottom.
desc5: To the north and south is Main Street. To the west is Dock Street and
desc6: the local merchants. To the east is Stargazer's Lane.
